bodies: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center

exams.name: Able Seafarer-Deck Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: STCW deck rating under Regulation II/5 requiring assessed competencies in navigation watch support, mooring and cargo handling.

exams.name: Able Seafarer-Engine Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: STCW engine rating under Regulation III/5 covering watchkeeping support, machinery operation and engine room maintenance tasks.

exams.name: Able Seaman Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Deck rating issued in grades from Special to Unlimited, requiring sea service plus an examination in seamanship and safety.

exams.name: Apprentice Mate (Steersman) of Towing Vessels
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Entry towing endorsement requiring 30 days of deck service and an examination before a mariner may begin supervised wheelhouse training.

exams.name: Assistance Towing Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Optional endorsement added to an OUPV or Master licence allowing the holder to tow disabled recreational vessels for hire.

exams.name: Auxiliary Sail Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Endorsement permitting a licensed operator to work on sail or auxiliary sail vessels after qualifying sea service and an exam module.

exams.name: Chief Engineer (Limited) Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Engineering licence for chief engineers on vessels of limited horsepower and tonnage, tested on motor and steam plant operation.

exams.name: Chief Mate Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Senior deck licence for vessels of any gross tons, requiring management-level STCW training plus extensive Coast Guard examination modules.

exams.name: Designated Duty Engineer Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Engineering licence for sole-engineer vessels, issued in horsepower tiers and requiring exams on diesel plants, electrical and auxiliary systems.

exams.name: First Class Pilot Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Route-specific federal pilotage endorsement earned by round trips over the route and a chart examination drawn from memory.

exams.name: Lifeboatman Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Rating endorsement requiring practical assessment in launching and handling survival craft, matched by the STCW proficiency in survival craft.

exams.name: Master of Towing Vessels
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Licence to command towing vessels on a specified route, earned through a towing officer assessment record and Coast Guard examination.

exams.name: Master of Vessels 1600 Gross Tons
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Deck licence for oceans, near coastal or inland service on vessels up to 1600 gross tons, requiring multi-module Coast Guard examinations.

exams.name: Master of Vessels 500 Gross Tons
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Mid-tier deck licence for vessels up to 500 gross tons covering navigation, stability, cargo handling and rules of the road.

exams.name: Master of Vessels Any Gross Tons
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Highest deck licence authorising command of vessels of unlimited tonnage on oceans, subject to management-level STCW and extensive exams.

exams.name: Master of Vessels Less Than 100 GRT
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Widely held captain licence for inspected passenger vessels under 100 gross tons, tested on deck general, deck safety, rules and chart plot.

exams.name: Master of Vessels Less Than 200 GRT
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Deck licence for vessels under 200 gross tons requiring additional sea service and examination beyond the 100 ton master level.

exams.name: Master of Vessels Less Than 25 GRT
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Entry master licence assigned when a mariner qualifying sea service is on vessels of very small tonnage under 46 CFR 11.422.

exams.name: Master of Vessels Less Than 50 GRT
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Master licence tier assigned from documented tonnage history, authorising command of inspected vessels under 50 gross tons.

exams.name: Mate (Pilot) of Towing Vessels
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Wheelhouse licence permitting a mariner to stand a navigation watch aboard towing vessels after completing assessed towing competencies.

exams.name: Mate of Vessels Less Than 200 GRT
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Deck licence authorising watchkeeping as mate on inspected vessels under 200 gross tons on inland or near coastal routes.
